name: Romulan
summary: **Romulan** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] developed by military veterans in British Columbia, [[country:CA|Canada]], starting from [[thai]] seed introduced in the late 1960s. [[colombian-gold|Colombian]] and [[afghani]] landraces were bred in over the following decade, and the line was known as Port Alberni Pinebud before being renamed Romulan. Some sources attribute its wider spread to a grower called Romulan Joe.

sources.title: Romulan Genetics
sources.note: Account of Romulan's origins among veteran growers in BC/Northern California.
